bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. No other bags are allowed inside.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are allowed after search. Diaper bags do not count as medical; diaper supplies must go in a clear bag. For concert questions, call Arena Management at 865-974-0953.

parking.note: Parking information is not detailed on the website. Visitors are encouraged to plan their visit in advance and check for any updates or specific instructions regarding parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Food City Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Food City Center offers a variety of food and drink options to enhance the event experience. While specific vendors are not listed, attendees can expect a range of traditional concession stand offerings. Special promotions or unique food items may be available during certain events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is located throughout the arena and is first-come, first-served when you order tickets. Staff can help with ushering and easy-access seating; call 865-974-0953 or visit the Customer Service window on the main concourse at Gate E, and send accessibility requests as early as possible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Food City Center has a no re-entry policy, and there are no pass-outs.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For concert and special event tickets, call 865-656-4444. For Tennessee Athletics events, call 865-656-1200.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance gates are at the top of the concrete pedestrian ramps on the east and west sides of the building, and the ticket office is at street level off Phillip Fulmer Way. Medical bag check is at Gate D on the east end.
